% Converted, ltx-talk, C-ALERTBLOCK workaround NOT applied -- the defect.
%
% ltx-talk has no alertblock/exampleblock at all (block IS native, which is the trap: a reader
% who knows that can conclude the same about these two). This is the improvisation that was
% actually observed: keep Beamer's \begin{alertblock}<2->{Title} call signature with an xparse
% d<>m wrapper and forward the title into a tcolorbox as [{#2}].
%
% [...] is tcolorbox's key=value OPTIONS argument, not a positional slot. The inner boxes here
% take a mandatory title argument, so the wrapper's [ is read as that argument -- title={[} --
% and the real title text is left in the box body.
%
% Measured on ltx-talk 0.6.2 / TeX Live 2026, lualatex, two passes, against after.tex:
%
%                          pages  Tagged  extracted text
%   after.tex (mandatory {})   1     yes  "Key result" / "The main finding."
%   this file  (d<>m + [{}])   1     yes  "[" / "Key result] The main finding."
%
% Clean compile, no warning, right page count, Tagged: yes, and both titles are gone -- a lone
% "[" sits where each title belongs. This one IS visible to pdftotext, so the fixture asserts
% on the text layer and needs no pixel measurement: the "]" welded to the title text is the
% signature.
%
% NB the wrapper is not the mistake -- forwarding a title into [ ] is. If a deck genuinely
% needs \begin{alertblock}<2->{Title}, keep an overlay-aware wrapper and pass the title to a
% real title key.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{cadmiumgreen}{rgb}{0.0, 0.42, 0.24}
\usepackage{tcolorbox}
\newtcolorbox{ltxalertblock}[1]{
  title={#1}, fonttitle=\bfseries,
  colback=red!8!white, colframe=red!70!black,
  left=4pt, right=4pt, top=2pt, bottom=2pt,
}
\newtcolorbox{ltxexampleblock}[1]{
  title={#1}, fonttitle=\bfseries,
  colback=cadmiumgreen!8!white, colframe=cadmiumgreen,
  left=4pt, right=4pt, top=2pt, bottom=2pt,
}
\NewDocumentEnvironment{alertblock}{d<>m}{\begin{ltxalertblock}[{#2}]}{\end{ltxalertblock}}
\NewDocumentEnvironment{exampleblock}{d<>m}{\begin{ltxexampleblock}[{#2}]}{\end{ltxexampleblock}}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}
  \begin{alertblock}{Key result}
    The main finding.
  \end{alertblock}
  \begin{exampleblock}{Worked example}
    Some example text.
  \end{exampleblock}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
